    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    center = next(( (r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid)
                   for c, value in enumerate(row) if value == 3), None)
    if center is None:

    # These offsets are the motif shown by the demonstrations, centered

    offsets = [

        if (
            (dr == -4 and -2 <= dc <= 4) or
            (dr == -3 and dc in (-2, 4)) or
            (dr == -2 and dc in (-2, 0, 1, 2, 4)) or
            (dr == -1 and dc in (-2, 0, 2, 4)) or
            (dr == 0 and dc in (-2, 0, 2, 4)) or
            (dr == 1 and dc in (-2, 0, 2, 4)) or
            (dr == 2 and dc in (-2, 0, 1, 2, 4)) or
            (dr == 3 and dc in (-2, 4)) or
            (dr == 4 and -4 <= dc <= 4)
        )
    ]
    for dr, dc in offsets:
        r, c = cr + dr, cc + dc
        if 0 <= r < len(out) and 0 <= c < len(out[0]) and out[r][c] == 0:
            out[r][c] = 3
    return out
